newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eridania eyes Polish sugar investment.
newsitem.headline: Eridania eyes Polish sugar investment.

text.p: Eridania Beghin-Say said on Tuesday that its Ceresucre unit was interested in buying 17 sugar refineries in Poland as part of the privatisation of the country's sugar industry.
"We are holding talks with the Polish government to participate in the sale (of the refineries)...We are interested in 17 refineries," a company spokesman told Reuters.
The 17 refineries, located in the eastern region of Silesia, are small plants which have a combined annual output of only 30,000 tonnes of sugar.
Eridania expects Polish authorities to take a decision on the sale later this year, possibly in autumn.
Eridania is already present in the Polish feed market through its Central Soya Rolpol holding and in the spices market through Ducros Polska.
It also controls three sugar refineries in Hungary, representing some 40 percent of national sugar production. The plants had a production capacity of 150,000 tonnes in 1995.
It controls 80 percent of Hungary's oilseeds crushing and refining market, processing 500,000 tonnes of sunflower seeds through the three plants of Cerol Magyarorszag.
Through the Agrokomplex company set up in 1991 Eridania is also active in the Hungarian animal feed market. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
